## Project

This project studies aerial bundled cables as a physical enforcement technology in electricity distribution networks. It examines whether making illegal connections more difficult reduces theft, improves payment, and strengthens utility finances—and whether those gains persist once households and local intermediaries adapt.

<p class="draft-note">Results are not yet available. For updates on this project, <a href="mailto:t.dobermann@lse.ac.uk">get in touch</a>.</p>
